acknowledged_parent_outcomes: PR254 first fixed simulations showed balanced q/w reference allocation outperformed q-heavy and w-heavy among 3 handpicked strategies in four source-free ecological truths. This new inference target is variance of detector log-OR; not a blind re-analysis of empirical data.
scientific_target: Sampling variance due only to independent eight distance-stratum camera q references and four target distance-mix passage references for a preselected early/late × rising/falling photoperiod log detector odds ratio; not full season-effect variance or causal clock identification.

analytic_target.q_variance_coefficient_A: sum over four cells [w_i^2 q_near_i(1-q_near_i)+(1-w_i)^2 q_far_i(1-q_far_i)]/p_i^2
analytic_target.leading_variance: Var(log_detector_OR_hat) ~= A/nq + C/nw, independent external reference streams, first-order delta method; NO claim exact at small n
analytic_target.continuous_delta_optimum: nq/nw=sqrt((4*A)/(8*C))=sqrt(A/(2*C)); only variance-optimal in ideal Bernoulli gold-standard cost assumptions, not best CP/Fisher certification policy

validation.rng: NumPy SeedSequence([seed, world_index, budget_index, strategy_index, 0]); vectorized eight Binomial(nq,q) and four Binomial(nw,w) across 800 independent gold-standard reference worlds
outputs: exact analytic A,C coefficients per truth
delta predicted q/w variance components and shares for 4×4×3=48 frozen scenarios
empirical variance of estimated log detector OR over independent q/w replicate calibrations for each of 48 scenarios
empirical bias of log detector OR and empirical standard error of sample variance
continuous optimum nq/nw per truth and implied q opportunity budget fraction
diagnostic relative discrepancy MC vs delta variance with fixed fail-closed numeric tolerance, no p-value
numerical_prerequisites: at least 99.5% reference replicate q estimates strictly positive in all eight cells and p_eff positive in all four cells; no pseudo counts, no silent imputation; if fails, status HOLD and report failure
empirical vs delta predicted variance differs by at most 20% when n_q>=100 and n_w>=100, else fail rather than retune; 800 worlds per scenario
variance decomposition is first-order asymptotic, not a frequentist confidence interval or proof of actual detector transport
C positive in every scenario and no policy based on animal outcomes

hard_gates: exact original 4 truths ×4 budgets ×3 strategies =48 contrasts; fixed 800 independent reference q/w draws for each scenario
all 8*nq+4*nw equal corresponding frozen budget, no equal-price assumption for real labor
each reference q and target w drawn independently with binomial correct n and frozen known true probability, never conditional on observed animal detections
q/w derivative variance additivity checked against independent reference Monte Carlo variance
all analytic A,C are nonnegative; q/w variance shares sum to 1; predictions decrease with total budget under identical allocation ratio
continuous optimum ratio verified by both calculus and bounded numerical objective checks
no claim that variance-optimal ratio necessarily maximizes rare-event robust CP/Fisher rejection power
original 41 daylength-mirror calendar pairs, common clock-bin prediction and all qualified source-refit inference unaffected
original EcoBank v1.1 events/device logs/restricted sites/independent sensor q/w opportunities not available; no ecological empirical result
limitation: Fixed one-site preselected 2-bin log q crossproduct only. Does not include camera-operation uncertainty, empirical animal Poisson variance, physical-site clustering, false-negative reference sensor, distance×speed variation, original source climate history or causal zeitgeber inference.
